findingMessages.p0006-doc-denoisemodel-doc-says-system-i: The doc comment on Dialog::DenoiseModel reads 'Help ▸ System Info: (label, value) rows.', but the variant holds {info, accepted} for the AI Denoise model licence and install dialog (rendered by panels::denoise::model_dialog, confirmed by denoise::install). The real SystemInfo variant (919-921) has no doc. Rustdoc and editor hovers send readers to the wrong dialog.
findingMessages.p0006-doc-confirm-dialog-doc-on-fmt-gap: The comment 'Apply a dialog's action (also used by `ui.dialog.confirm`).' sits directly above fmt_gap and merges into its rustdoc. fmt_gap only formats seconds ('90' → '1 min 30 s'). The function the comment describes, confirm_dialog (1571), is public and the control channel's confirm entry point, yet it has no doc. Readers of fmt_gap's doc are told it applies dialog actions, and the confirm contract is undocumented.
findingMessages.p0006-doc-meta-field-doc-on-copyright-st: The doc for meta_field ('A labelled metadata text field: the typed text lives in egui memory while focused and is saved (photo.setMeta `key`) when the field loses focus.') is stacked onto copyright_status, a ComboBox that saves immediately on selection. The result is one contradictory doc on copyright_status, while meta_field (788) has none. Anyone reading copyright_status's doc expects focus-loss saving that it doesn't do.
findingMessages.p0006-doc-settings-tabs-list-stale: Dialog::Settings documents `tab` = general | import | performance | interface. settings::TABS (settings.rs:21-29) also has display, faces and denoise, and the dialog body dispatches on them. A control-channel client or agent following the variant doc (Dialog is set and read through ui.set/ui.get) will never open the Display, Faces or AI Denoise tabs, and will treat those values as invalid.
findingMessages.p0006-doc-sam-help-points-to-upstream-re: Every user-facing project link is centralized in links.rs and points to the Ember repository (github.com/Orthic-Labs/ember: HELP, GITHUB, FEEDBACK). The SAM 3 install guide link in the dialog is hard-coded to the upstream repository instead: storytold/lightcraft/blob/main/docs/ai-masks.md. Ember ships its own docs/ai-masks.md with the 'Getting the model' section, which describes Ember's own dialog text. A user following the in-app manual-install guide gets the upstream project's instructions, which can diverge from Ember's (model folder, mirrors, env vars), or a dead link if upstream moves the file.
findingMessages.p0006-doc-tests-masking-module-scope: The module doc says the file holds headless tests of the Masking and Remove tools. The file also covers the crop tool (464-540), keyword sets (542-561), the smart-album rule editor (563-800+), the Local folder tree, slideshow, external editors, grid performance and soft proofing. Someone looking for smart-album or crop coverage won't find it under the matching tests_* module, and new tests in those areas may duplicate it.
